2610.13637.title: Model-agnostic Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning for Weakly Annotated Bioimaging Data
2610.13637.paper_summary: Machine learning models are increasingly used for automated feature extraction from weakly annotated bioimaging data, such as microscopy and cytomorphology images. Due to the sole dependency of automated feature extraction, existing methods yield inconsistent classification performance across weakly annotated datasets. Here, we propose a model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that enables ML models to exploit domain knowledge beyond what automated feature extraction can capture. The proposed approach improves classification performance across seven ML architectures. When integrated with masked autoencoder-based self-supervised learning, our method achieves the strongest overall performance, improving precision by 2.9% over the next-best method on three in-house microscopy datasets and by an average of 6.8% across three public cytomorphology benchmarks. We perform nucleus-level classification based on mislocalization of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, a phenotype linked to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), using three independent microscopy datasets of motor neurons derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells. Accurate quantification of this phenotype at scale remains challenging and may contribute to inconsistencies across studies. Application of the best-performing model to these microscopy datasets reveals biological interpretations related to ALS, including dose-dependent effects of the proteasomal stressor, MG132, and the oxidative stressor, sodium arsenite (SA), on TDP-43 mislocalization, variable pathology in motor neurons from sporadic and familial ALS donors, and a lack of protection of the pharmacological compounds, edaravone and niclosamide, against SA-induced TDP-43 mislocalization. Together, our pipeline enables in-vitro cellular image analysis to advance understanding of ALS-associated pathology and potential treatments.
2610.13637.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習模型越來越多地用於從弱標註的生物影像數據中自動提取特徵，例如顯微鏡和細胞形態學影像。由於自動特徵提取的唯一依賴性，現有方法在弱標註數據集上的分類性能不一致。在此，我們提出了一種模型無關的知識增強方法，使機器學習模型能夠利用超出自動特徵提取所能捕捉的領域知識。所提出的方法改善了七種機器學習架構的分類性能。當與基於遮罩自編碼器的自我監督學習結合時，我們的方法在三個內部顯微鏡數據集上比下一最佳方法提高了2.9%的精確度，並在三個公共細胞形態學基準上平均提高了6.8%。我們基於TAR DNA結合蛋白43（TDP-43）從細胞核錯位到細胞質的錯位進行核級分類，這一表型與肌萎縮側索硬化症（ALS）相關，使用了三個來自人類誘導多能幹細胞的運動神經元的獨立顯微鏡數據集。在大規模準確量化這一表型方面仍然存在挑戰，並可能導致研究之間的不一致。將表現最佳的模型應用於這些顯微鏡數據集揭示了與ALS相關的生物學解釋，包括蛋白酶體壓力因子MG132和氧化壓力因子砷酸鈉（SA）對TDP-43錯位的劑量依賴效應、來自散發性和家族性ALS捐贈者的運動神經元的可變病理，以及藥物化合物edaravone和niclosamide對SA誘導的TDP-43錯位缺乏保護作用。總體而言，我們的流程使體外細胞影像分析能夠推進對ALS相關病理及潛在治療的理解。
